analysis.reasonEn:
RSI confirmed exiting oversold at 34.9→42.2, 2 trading days after the prior buy signal.
MACD histogram also improved from -0.5087 to -0.2446, entering a weak convergence zone.
Proximity to weekly SMA100 support at $69.51 and the initial formation of a Higher Low from the 5-day low of $62.50 strengthen the buy entry rationale.
